The [[Time/Legends|year]] '''3642 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a time period that brought significant changes to the state of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Also known as the year '''11 after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] (ATC)''', it marked the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the renewal of hostilities that would lead to the [[Galactic War]] one year later. A galaxy-spanning conflict similar to the [[Great Galactic War|first]], the second war's origins could be traced back to numerous events and proxy wars between the two galactic powers during the [[3653 BBY|previous]] [[3643 BBY|decade]] and the early months of the year. Conflicts from the year before such as the [[Desolator crisis]], [[Plan Zero]], and the [[SpecForce Incident|defection]] of the Republic's [[Havoc Squad]] served to increase the tensions between the Empire and Republic, and open warfare soon broke out in when the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] was [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberated]] from Imperial control and the Empire [[Invasion of Taris|conquered]] the world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The [[Battle of the Maelstrom|freeing]] of the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] was one of the event that finally sparked the Empire into action, marking the end of the Cold War and an inevitable return to open conflict.

==Events==
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] is [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|freed]] from [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] control by the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Balmorran resistance]].<ref name="TOR:PtT" />
*The Empire [[Invasion of Taris|occupies]] the Republic world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], effectively halting the Republic [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|resettlement project]].
*The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] is [[Battle of the Maelstrom|freed]] from [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|the Maelstrom]] prison after over [[3950 BBY|three hundred years]] of captivity by a Republic strike team.<ref name="TOR:TJP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>
*Revan's attempts to use the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as the [[Foundry (space station)|Foundry]] are [[Battle of the Foundry|halted]] by an Imperial strike force.<ref name="TOR:CtA">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Call to Arms|the ''White Nova''}}</ref> The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malgus]] later takes control of the station for his own purposes.<ref name="TOR:TFE">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref>
